Bhullaka
ref. to by Kṣemarāja a. Bṛhaṭṭīkākāra. q. by him in his C. Uddyota on Svacchandatantra an. his views refuted, p.. 178, 194, 199, 273, 317, 355, 359, Pariamal Granth, 16. Delhi, 1985.

Bhūlokakailāsamāhātmya
from the Brahmottarakhaṇḍa of the Skandapurāṇa. Burnell 194b.

Bhūlokamalla
also known a. Someśvara IV or Sarvajña Cālukya (1126-1138 A. D.), king of Kalyan, patron of Vidyāmādhava (a. of Pārvatīrukmiṇīya). See M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL.
